svg.title: What Q-NEXUS does
svg.desc: Tender to RFQ list: A tender registry with schedule and team, and an RFQ list that passes an approval gate before anything goes out. BOQ versions: Bill of quantities in numbered revisions, with Excel import. RFQs and quotations are tied to the version they priced. Reading vendor offers: Excel is parsed without AI. An AI agent reads PDF and Word, and each number must be found in the document or it is rejected. Evaluation and recommendation: A technical evaluation matrix, a commercial evaluation, and a recommendation weighted 60% price and 40% technical. Clarification and closing: Schedule clarification and negotiation rounds. Closing paths cover re-RFQ, failed, cancelled, merged and reopened archives. Price and vendor databases: A price database with trends, and a vendor database with categories and a blacklist. Documents live in folders with sharing. Per-user data assistant: Each user has an AI agent that reads data over read-only MCP, limited to what that user's screen would show. Audit and practice mode: An immutable audit trail, role dashboards with a TV-mode observer view, and a practice mode that uses synthetic prices.
svg.text: The parts of Q-NEXUS people use every day.
